title: Vault (KMS)
description: Optional. Leave this empty and the server does not connect to Vault. Buckets can still use the server key.
addrHint: The address of your Vault, for example https://vault.example:8200. Each storage node uses this same address unless its own environment variable overrides it.
authHint: AppRole is the usual choice: Vault gives this node a Role ID and a Secret ID. A token is a single secret from a file or the form.
roleIdHint: Identifies which Vault role this node logs in as. It is not the Secret ID.
secretIdHint: The password for the AppRole. After you save it, this field only shows that a value is stored. Type a new one to replace it.
tokenHint: A Vault token. After you save it, the field only shows that a value is stored. Type a new one to replace it.
mountHint: Where the Transit engine is mounted. The usual value is transit.
namespaceHint: Only for Vault Enterprise. Leave empty on the open-source server.
caHint: Paste the PEM certificate, or the path to the file on the server, when Vault uses a private CA.
saveNeedTest: Test the connection before saving. A failed test is not stored.
nodesHint: Each storage node reports whether it can reach Vault. One node can be down while the others still work.

error.timeout: The server did not answer in 5 s
